items.title: What Are Merck Stock Investors Overlooking?
items.summary: If you own Merck (MRK) stock, the number to watch is the sales of one cancer drug family. KEYTRUDA family sales were $8.4 billion in the second quarter of 2026. That was about half of Merck's $16.6 billion in quarterly revenue. Management now expects KEYTRUDA’s U.S. growth to moderate, raising questions about whether the stock's recent run has fully priced in the transition.

items.title: Johnson & Johnson’s Next Growth Engine Is Taking Shape
items.summary: Johnson & Johnson's oncology and immunology pipeline is firing on multiple cylinders, but a collapsing blockbuster drug and mounting litigation costs threaten to cancel out every gain. Here is whether the bull case or the headwinds win.

items.title: Merck, Daiichi Withdraw FDA Filing for Lung Cancer Therapy
items.summary: MRK and Daiichi withdraw an FDA filing for ifinatamab deruxtecan after data falls short, while late-stage studies continue.

items.title: FDA Expands Merck's Welireg Label for a New Kidney Cancer Indication

items.title: Merck, Daiichi end plans to seek speedy approval of lung cancer ADC
items.summary: The FDA indicated that the data generated so far wouldn’t support an accelerated clearance of “I-DXd,” a setback that erases an edge Merck and Daiichi had over multiple fast-moving competitors.
